name: climb
summary: Climb nights: on a schedule, an agent improves one number (the suite's time, a flaky test, the build's time, the project's own benchmark) or proposes for the owner (a distill pass over its lessons, a rank for each Loop finding) under a shared protocol; a script makes every measurement and keep-or-revert, and a person merges the one PR and decides every proposal. With "tend" set, a weekly tend pass resolves the night's record findings the same way.

secrets.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
secrets.why: Claude's credential (`claude setup-token`), as the claude practice's; each climb night spends model tokens up to .keel/keel.json climb.budget.minutes. Either this or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; until one is set the run ends green with a notice

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.why: the alternative to CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, billed per token to the API account; set one of the two, not both

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.why: Codex's credential, only when climb.agent is "codex" (and "agents" lists codex): each climb night spends tokens billed to the OpenAI API account (no subscription path), up to climb.budget.minutes; until it is set a Codex night ends green with a notice

secrets.name: STITCH_API_KEY
secrets.why: a loop night's pull (the loop practice's key); without it the night proposes for the findings already pulled, with a notice

secrets.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
secrets.why: the same credential, for the weekly tend pass; it spends model tokens up to .keel/keel.json tend.budget.minutes, and only when "tend" is set

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.why: the alternative to CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN for the tend pass; set one of the two, not both

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.why: Codex's credential for the tend pass, only when tend.agent is "codex": billed per token to the OpenAI API account, up to tend.budget.minutes

secrets.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
secrets.why: Robot build and other-provider review share the explicitly approved robot.budgetMinutes weekly allowance; robot remains off without robot.on.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
